offering_description.value: Provides investment advisory and asset management services, mainly value-oriented mutual funds, ETFs and separately managed accounts for individuals, institutions and high-net-worth investors. Earns fees from assets under management and distributes through its own and third-party channels.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; closed-end funds; separately managed accounts; alternative investment partnerships

primary_services.value: investment advisory; portfolio management; institutional and sub-advisory management; fund distribution

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual and high-net-worth investors in funds and managed accounts; B2B: institutions, pension funds, foundations, endowments and advisors

end_markets.value: asset management; wealth management; institutional investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: advisory fees based on assets under management in funds and accounts; commissions or management fees: performance-based incentive fees from certain partnerships and accounts; other: distribution fees and sales charges on fund shares
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; commissions or management fees; other

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: manages client assets in securities, sold to investors, institutions and advisors

geography_served.value: global: Based in Connecticut and New York, serving primarily US investors with some international clients

specialization.value: related lines: mutual funds, ETFs, separate accounts and partnerships sharing value-investing research

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to institutions and high-net-worth clients; partners / resellers: third-party broker-dealers, financial advisors and platforms selling funds; online: direct fund purchases through website

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and broker-dealer regulated by SEC and FINRA under Investment Advisers and Investment Company Acts

notes: Company's public status may have changed recently; description based on its asset management operations.
